text: 道指开盘跌0.57%，纳指涨0.08%，标普500跌0.01%。明星科技股高通涨6.91%，英特尔涨5.22%，美国超微公司涨2.38%。纳斯达克中国金龙指数跌1.36%，哔哩哔哩涨3.87%，百度跌7.75%。
text_en: The Dow opened down 0.57%, the Nasdaq rose 0.08%, and the S&P 500 fell 0.01%. Among notable tech stocks, Qualcomm rose 6.91%, Intel rose 5.22%, and AMD rose 2.38%. The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index fell 1.36%, Bilibili rose 3.87%, and Baidu fell 7.75%.
